official_public_baseline.verification: Wheel METADATA and selected parser members read through HTTP Range; the complete wheel was not downloaded or hashed.
official_public_baseline.scope: Identifies the public official baseline; does not attest a private scorer container or its runtime digest.

modifications: Only non-streaming default/auto-tool response assembly is retained. vLLM protocol objects become plain dictionaries; Policy still owns call IDs and OpenAI response assembly.
Reasoning extraction precedes tool extraction. Prompt IDs only prime fast detokenization and never affect reasoning extraction.

Uses existing tokenizers DecodeStream with skip_special_tokens=False and the official default spaces_between_special_tokens=True. Caller supplies actual generation stop IDs; only a sampled final stop token is omitted from display, not from generation evidence.
No JSON repair, tool-name inference, schema validation, parameter mutation, or fallback to another parser. Upstream ordinary tool-extraction exception fallback returns original content.
args_str[i:].startswith(delimiter) is replaced with args_str.startswith(delimiter,i), avoiding repeated suffix copies without changing the match.
Explicit execution limits: 32768 IDs per prompt/completion, 1048576 decoded characters, nesting depth 128, 4194304 scan iterations, regex timeout 2 seconds.

A non-advancing bare-array branch, exceeded limits, and resource/decoder failures raise Gemma4ParseExecutionError(ValueError) so raw generation is retained; these failures bypass ordinary content fallback.
No streaming parser, slow-tokenizer backend, forced tool choice, custom stop strings, or alternate detokenization settings are supported.

manual_validation.method: One-off Python commands, no test files or vLLM installation. Actual v0.19.1 AST class/function definitions executed with protocol/base stubs only; source parser bodies were not rewritten.
manual_validation.argument_cases: 13 complete/partial cases, including missing string close, nested objects and arrays, bare quoted strings, Unicode, duplicate keys, incomplete containers.
manual_validation.fast_detokenizer_scope: Actual upstream FastIncrementalDetokenizer vs adapter using tokenizers 0.22.2 synthetic byte-level tokenizer; prompt/no prompt, Unicode, whitespace, EOS/turn stops. Real checkpoint tokenizer remains for caller/server validation.
manual_validation.bounded_failure: Confirmed upstream non-progress both in _parse_gemma4_array and complete extract_tool_calls with 100ms external interrupt; adapter raises Gemma4ParseExecutionError. Scan/nesting exhaustion and regex timeout also escape content fallback.
manual_validation.ordinary_fallback: Injected ordinary ValueError yields unchanged original content in upstream and adapter.
manual_validation.generation_evidence: Decode checks leave input completion ID lists unchanged.
